# Phase 5B.3: Discrepancy Hierarchy

## Discrepancy variants
- source_native_invariant: Frobenius-norm difference; frame-independent.
- exact_transported: MP tensor rotated into the JARVIS Cartesian frame.
- proper_orbit: minimum over proper rotations in the common point group.
- domain_aware: allows inversion-related polar-domain flip.
- point_group_equivalent: minimum over the full common point group.
- symmetry_projected: after Reynolds projection onto the common point group.
